policy: Use official downloads/API, pin actual release or accession, inspect file-specific terms and original study overlap. Registry inclusion is not a claim of independent validation or unrestricted reuse.

sources.name: Sanger GDSC fitted drug response release8.5
sources.reuse_basis: Official Cell Model Passports footer refers to Sanger terms: research use/publications require source acknowledgement; hosted content defaults CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 unless otherwise stated. This project performs internal noncommercial analysis with attribution; no raw redistribution or claim of a file-specific unrestricted licence. Preserve dated terms snapshot and dataset citations.
sources.recommended_start: Release8.5 exact fitted XLSX files, each below30MB; keep stable model IDs, DrugIDs and official compound mappings. Experimental support coarsening is not true censoring or a confidence interval.

Same compound may have multiple DrugIDs
Released phenotypes use multilevel joint curve fitting
Point fits beyond dose support are extrapolations
